fit_contract.objective: same U3_P90_S90 Student-t4 joint population/conditional objective used in temporal and spatial validation
fit_contract.optimizer: AdamW then strong-Wolfe L-BFGS with projected KKT <=1e-5
fit_contract.attribute_preprocessing: fit once from reaches represented in the full 2021-2024 development observations

products.population_transferable: monthly TN predictions for all 230 reaches in 2021-2024, with reach outlet fraction=1
products.gauged_conditional: descriptive full-development fitted predictions for monitored stations only
products.uncertainty_boundary: nested OOF intervals are validation uncertainty; the full-refit product does not claim per-cell predictive intervals

promotion_rule: promote only if Stage5 spatial gates passed, full refit satisfies KKT and finite-output checks, and transferable offset remains within the registered 1.0 log-unit envelope
forbidden: new TN lag or groundwater store
overwriting prior locks or prior production products
